name: 28103 · Marshville, NC
findings: ZIP 28103 (Marshville) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28103 (Marshville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
